claims.text: A 12-year-old boy presented to clinic with a firm, nodular mass on the medial aspect of the right knee present for about 1 year, with gradual enlargement over the last 3 months and mild tenderness but no pruritus or pain. Examination showed a dark brown-black nodule of about 1 × 1 cm with two small peripheral nodular extensions, without ulceration or crusting, and a negative dimple sign. There was no history of skin or other systemic disease.
